ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In the figure below, Figure 1 is “a topographic profile of a certain continent”, Figure 2 is “part of a certain imaginary land”, and Figure 3 is “a schematic diagram of Earth's revolution around the Sun”. (Answer with the letter in Figure 3)

raw_record.original_question:

<image1>

在图1大气环流所示季节，图3中地球绕日公转大约位于轨道上的哪个位置？（用图3中的字母作答）

Figure 3 is a schematic diagram of Earth's revolution around the Sun, with positions such as a, b, c, and d marked on the orbit, among which the position indicating the Northern Hemisphere tilting toward the Sun and being near the summer solstice is marked as a.
Then reason: In Figure 1, the main ascending air current and convergence zone are biased north of the Equator, indicating that the subsolar point has moved north, belonging to the Northern Hemisphere summer. In Northern Hemisphere summer, Earth on its revolution orbit should be at the position where the Northern Hemisphere tilts toward the Sun and around the summer solstice; from the corresponding letter in Figure 3, it is known to be a.
